tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi sgrub thabs bsdus pa bzhugs so// swa sti/ dkon mchog la skyabs byang sems bskyed/ lan gsum sogs ci rigs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad zla'i steng / /rang nyid spyan ras gzigs dbang dkar/ /phyag bzhi dang po thugs kar ni/ /thal sbyar g.yas gnyis shel phreng dang / /g.yon gnyis pad steng nor bu rnams/ /spyan gnyis zhal 'dzum ral cog can/ /rin chen dar gyi rgyan gos mdzes/ /kriṣ+ṇa'i pags pas nu g.yon bkab/ /rdo rje skyil krung stabs kyis bzhugs/ /de yi thugs kar hrīḥdakar mthar/ /yi ge drug mas bskor ba las/ /'od 'phros bdag dang 'gro drug gi /sdig sbyangs 'phags pa'i byin rlabs zhugs/ /oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ zhes ci nus mthar/ jo bos bdag dang sems can la/ /gnas skabs mthar thug dngos grub stsol/ /dge bas bdag gzhan sgrib byang nas/ /'phags pa'i go 'phang myur thob shog /ces 'di sa skya pa kun blos/ /glo mo phun tshogs sgrol ngor bris/ /me bya zla 5 tshes/ ༈ gsol 'debs srid zhi'i mchog gyur bzhugs so// //na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ bsod nams kha ba'i lhun por legs bzhugs shing / /lung rtogs bdag med seng ge'i nga ro can/ /gang de'i ring lugs pad+mo bzhad pa'i tshal/ /bstan 'dzin sbrang rtsi'i rgyal mtshan la phyag 'tshal/ /kun tu mkhyen gsal brtse ba'i khur ldan zhing / /mthu stobs nus pa phyogs dus rnam kun tu/ /bstan dang 'gro la phan pa lhur bzhes pa'i/ /chos rje snyigs dus dpal mgon la phyag 'tshal/ /dpal ldan sa skya'i rje btsun bka' srol mchog /thun mong min pa'i dgongs 'grel mkhas grub che/ /kun mkhyen smra ba'i seng ge'i gdan sa pa/ /'gran bral phyogs las rnam rgyal la phyag 'tshal/ /de ltar gsol bas gzhan gnod gzhir bcas bral/ /byams dang snying rje smon 'jug byang sems 'byongs/ /smin grol bdud rtsi'i ro dang mi bral bas/ /rgyal ba'i bstan la bya ba byed par shog

/bdag cag mthong thos dran reg thams cad kyang / /gnas skabs rgud bral bde dge'i dpal 'byor rgyas/ /sa lam mthar phyin kun mkhyen rgyal ba yi/ /go 'phang myur thob srid zhi'i mchog gyur cig /ces pa 'di yang sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros la thub bstan rnam rgyal gyi mkhan rin po che pad+ma rgyal mtshan gyi dbon rnams nas gsol 'debs 'di bzhin bskul ba ltar rgyal ba'i chos 'khor bskor ba'i dus chen nyin sbyar ba'o// //me bya lor/ sarba maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi sgrub thabs bsdus pa/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
